### About the Data

All visitation records used in this project come from the official National Park Service Visitor Use Statistics program, accessible through the [NPS IRMA Stats Portal](https://irma.nps.gov/Stats/) and the [NPS Visitor Use Statistics Dashboard](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/socialscience/visitor-use-statistics-dashboard.htm). The dataset covers calendar-year recreation visits from 2000 through 2025 across 400 reporting units in the National Park System, providing 9,612 verified park-year observations. Annual recreation visits measure entries into park units recorded by NPS field staff, permit systems, and automated counters.
:::
